evals.name: outline-and-font-gate
evals.prompt: /ppt Create a 6-slide technical overview from the attached project.md. Ask for purpose, audience, slide count, language, brand, and heading/body fonts; show the outline and wait for approval before rendering.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks the mandatory interview questions, confirms two installed fonts, writes an outline, and does not create a PPTX before explicit approval.

evals.name: semantic-pipeline-deck
evals.prompt: /ppt Turn the supplied markdown and PDF notes into a 10-slide engineering deck. Use a native pipeline and architecture slide, preserve numeric claims with source excerpts, and finish only after render and QA pass.
evals.expected_output: The output is an editable PPTX with semantic pipeline/architecture layouts, source-grounded numbers, montage QA, and a passing qa.json.

evals.name: font-hard-fail
evals.prompt: /ppt Use the supplied raw PPTX template and create a proposal deck. The contract requests a missing font; do not silently substitute it. Ask me to choose an installed heading/body pair or stop before rendering.
evals.expected_output: The skill blocks generation until both confirmed fonts are installed and never reports a fallback deck as complete.

evals.name: compound-proposal-quality-gate
evals.prompt: /ppt Create an executive transformation proposal from the supplied audit. Keep the deck concise, explicitly select a composition for every slide, combine diagnosis, evidence, and action where that makes the message clearer, and require the user to confirm heading/body fonts plus delivery mode before rendering.
evals.expected_output: The outline contains valid layout/composition pairs, font delivery is explicit, repetitive composition is repaired before release, and the QA report contains observed-font and embedded-font evidence.
